The canonical Omarchy base image — plain Arch plus Omarchy's own package
sources and runtime.
Omarchy publishes no container image, only an installer ISO, so what makes
this image Omarchy is the package set and the repositories it comes from,
both supplied by the omarchy-base layer. This box is the pod-safe floor: the
boot and display stack arrives as a hard dependency of the omarchy package
and is left inert, while machine-only surfaces belong to the machine images.
Its own observable claim is the one thing no layer can assert for it — that
the [omarchy, arch] tag chain resolved, so Omarchy's package sources are in
effect on an Arch base.

## Composition

This box composes:

- `@github.com/opencharly/layer-omarchy-base/candy/omarchy-base:v2026.242.0701`
